title: Vision-aligned Latent Reasoning for Multi-modal Large Language Model

layout.note: Panel (a), a wide tall LLM with token rows above and below, fills the left four fifths; panel (b), a narrower rounded panel, sits at the right and is tied to the hatched middle block by wedge-shaped frame lines, like a zoomed-out branch.

lesson: Draw a latent-token scheme by unrolling the token sequence along the bottom of one tall model, colour tokens by type and show the feedback as thick arrows from output hidden states back to the next input slots; attach the training-only branch as a wedge-shaped panel running back to the one hatched layer it reads.
